sloka: न एव चित्रम् सपत्नेषु पापम् लक्ष्मण यत् भवेत् ।त्वत् विधेषु नृशंसेषु नित्यम् प्रच्छन्न चारिषु ॥३-४५-२३॥
transliteration: na eva citram sapatneṣu pāpam lakṣmaṇa yat bhavet ।tvat vidheṣu nṛśaṁseṣu nityam pracchanna cāriṣu ॥3-45-23॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana,do you speak such words seeing the disaster of Rama? No wonder that cruel men who always move like you in disguise will thus resort to sinful action against rivals.
